falseSynonyms.zh: be inclined to 更偏個人意向、偏好或判斷；tend to 還可描述非人的規律。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is inclined to agree. Metal tends to expand when heated.

falseSynonyms.zh: usually 是頻率副詞，表示大多數時候如此；tend to 更像一般模式或傾向。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The train usually arrives on time. Prices tend to rise when demand increases.

falseSynonyms.zh: be likely to 核心是概率／預測；tend to 更常描述反覆模式或習慣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Prices are likely to rise next month. Prices tend to rise when demand is strong.

falseSynonyms.zh: often 只表示頻率高；tend to 可以有 disposition/pattern 意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He often arrives early. He tends to avoid conflict.

falseSynonyms.zh: be prone to 通常更負面，表示容易出現問題、疾病、損壞等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Older pipes are prone to leaks. People tend to prefer familiar options.

falseSynonyms.zh: tend 是動詞；tendency 是名詞。改成 have a tendency to 時句型必須重組。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON People tend to worry. People have a tendency to worry.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者不是同義詞。tend 表示傾向；intend 表示打算。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She tends to arrive early. She intends to arrive early.

falseSynonyms.zh: tend 是動詞；trend 通常是名詞，表示趨勢。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Costs tend to rise. The long-term trend is upward.
